bibliographic.title: My Desk
bibliographic.author: Matthias Conrady
bibliographic.description:
Snoop around my desk and check out my personal stuff!

You can look at things on my desk, learn about this moment in my life at the fringe of a long-distance-relationship.

In a way a documentary-game, heavy on images.
